answer: A night courier carries a sealed pouch from the north jetty office to a city vault in the 22:00-22:17 window, leaving a 7-byte route cipher plus 8.8 POA bond. A raven loft on the vault roof returns a unique tag that must match the pouch stamp; two unaffiliated night auditors, each limited to one tag this epoch, recheck it against the loft log within 8 minutes. A 4,400-key farm needs 4,400 exclusive tags, 38,720 POA, and 4,400 slots in that 17-minute window. A late arrival, a reused tag, or a loft issuing two tags to one courier burns 64% of the bond and grounds that loft for seven epochs.
